thread:
sam-support: :rotating_light: Customer (ACME Corp) reports sudden p99 spike on /v1/generate starting ~08:20 UTC. Multiple 429s and long tails (~6-8s). Request IDs: req-abc123, req-def456. Repro steps attached by customer. Escalating for triage — can oncall take a look?

oncall-bot: Alert: p99 latency > 4s for /v1/generate (region: us-west). Shards 12-14 showing queue depth > 120. Avg concurrency 480/200. Links: http://dash/infer/alerts/6754321000

eli: looking at heap and queue metrics now. worker-gpu-3 showing allocation churn + long GC pauses. backlog growing on admission queue. Hypothesis: long-running requests (large max_tokens) from a burst, causing batch tail latency and KV-cache thrash.

tilly: any deploys rolled out in the last 6h? also check if batch_timeout or batch_size overrides changed last night — saw a config bump in staging.

jordan: no prod deploys from infra last 24h. logs show these requests originate from ACME client ID ak_*****. Example log: `2026-03-17T08:21:14Z req-abc123 start gen tokens=2048 batch=1 duration=0ms` then per-token latency jumps after ~512 tokens.

sam-support: I have the customer's repro curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer AK' -d '{"prompt":"<long>","max_tokens":2048}'` — they say traffic started at 08:18 and peaked 08:22. They want temporary mitigation while you investigate.

eli: suggested mitigations (quick): 1) temporarily route ACME to a quantized lower-memory model variant to reduce per-token latency (fastest). 2) tighten per-request max_tokens to 1024 via routing policy for their tenant. 3) raise admission rate threshold for enterprise tenants to avoid waitlisting on dedicated pools. Can we do #1 quickly?

tilly: I can flip a routing rule to fallback model-xq-8g-quant for tenant ak_***** for 30m. Doing now. Command: `redwoodctl routes add --tenant ak_***** --route /v1/generate --model model-xq-8g-quant --duration 30m --reason "p99 mitigation"`

oncall-bot: Route change started by tilly at 08:42 UTC.

oncall-bot: Route change completed successfully.

eli: Observability after route swap: p95 for ACME dropped from ~1.5s -> ~0.6s, p99 improved to ~1.2s (still above normal but far better). Queue depth on shards 12-14 down to ~30. No new 429s observed.

jordan: I'll open a small PR to add prefix KV caching for the repeated prompt pattern (we saw identical prefixes across many requests) and a quick admission tweak to limit max_tokens per-request at the gateway for non-premium plans. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/7654

sam-support: Customer reports improved UX and no more 429s, thanks team :thumbsup:. Keeping thread open to monitor for 2h, then follow up with a short postmortem and recommended permanent fixes (KV cache, model-size routing, and tighter per-tenant rate caps).

eli: action items: eli -> monitor for 2h and post metrics; tilly -> revert routing after 30m or extend if still needed; jordan -> PR + deploy KV cache change; sam-support -> customer follow-up and SLA note.

tilly: noted, will post rollout link + timestamps in the postmortem.

sam-support: closing loop with ACME in 30m, will update thread. Thanks everyone.
